newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - LOCAL SHARES STILL STRONG.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - LOCAL SHARES STILL STRONG.

text.p: The Botswana Stock Exchange
continued upwards with the index adding 14.5 points on the week
to close at 523.69.
Bank stocks Barclays and Standard Chartered
had an excellent week with Barclays trading at 860 thebe from
840 thebe and bid at 900.
Standard Chartered traded at 695 thebe and remained 65 thebe
up at the close after being strongly bid at 700 thebe.
Botswana Insurance put on 11 percent, closing up 3O
thebe at 300. Parcels of brewery holding company Sechaba
shares traded at 420 thebe and 425 thebe before the
stock closed the week up 15 at 425.
Trading unchanged were oil company stock Engen at
450 thebe, security group Inco at 105 thebe and milling
company and food wholesaler Sefalana at 510 thebe.
Unchanged on the week and untraded were First
National with buyers only at 565 thebe, investment
company Kgolo ya Sechaba at 170/190 thebe and food and
tobacco wholesaler Metsef with buyers only at 680 thebe.
Also unchanged and untraded were clothing chain Pep
with buyers only at 325 thebe and variable loan stock company
RDC Properties with buyers only at 180 thebe.
Domestic trade and values were well up, with 1,694,375
(328,000) shares changing hands for a value of 7,132,305
On the foreign board De Beers put on 11 thebe to
13,133 thebe. Other counters showed single thebe gains as the
result of foreign exchange fluctuations.
Turnover was up with 51,600 (nil) shares traded.
The foreign index put on 3.62 points to close at 406.93 and
the all companies index added 3.89 points to 409.91.
